    B.a = 0 → IsSectionOn P A s →

          (multAt (P ⊔ Ideal.span {s}) W : ℝ) * ptsIntegral W (pot L) (fun z => Real.log (B.h z))) -
        ptsIntegral P (Fin.cons (fun z => Real.log (A.h z)) (pot L)) (fun z => Real.log (B.h z))

  (∀ i w, ∃ Z : Set ((Fin (F₀.C.a i) → ℂˣ) × (Fin (n - F₀.C.a i) → ℂˣ)), Z.Finite ∧
    ∀ s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D, F₀.Cand (F₀.loc T' c e b) i s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D → w ∈ T' →
      ∀ ξa ξb, JEig Pa Pb w (F₀.d₀.ϖ w) ξa ξb → (ξa, ξb) ∈ Z) ∧
  (∀ w ∈ F₀.d₀.S₀, ∃ (k : ℕ) (Dl : Fin k → Pre E n), ∀ i s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D, F₀.Cand (F₀.loc T' c e b) i s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D →
    ∃ j, (∀ τ : SmIrr (GLw n w), GlobalTheory.SmGL.IsSubquotient τ.ρ (prodAt D w) ↔ GlobalTheory.SmGL.IsSubquotient τ.ρ (prodAt (Dl j) w)) ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(fixed (prodAt D w) (F₀.d₀.K' w)) = Module.finrank ℂ ↥(fixed (prodAt (Dl j) w) (F₀.d₀.K' w)) ∧
      FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥(fixed (prodAt (Dl j) w) (F₀.d₀.K' w))) ∧
  ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ i s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D, F₀.Cand (F₀.loc T' c e b) i s₁ s₂ Pa Pb D → ∀ w ∈ T',
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(fixed (pairAt Pa Pb w) (I2 (F₀.C.a i) (n - F₀.C.a i) w)) ≤ m₀

def HolomorphicLefschetzFormula : Prop :=
  ∀ (Z : Scheme.{0}) (s : Z ⟶ Sp ℂ) (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d s], IsProjOver s →
  ∀ (Y : Scheme.{0}) (s' : Y ⟶ Sp ℂ) (c1 c2 : Y ⟶ Z) (h1 : c1 ≫ s = s') (h2 : c2 ≫ s = s') [IsFinite c1] [Etale c1],
  IsFinite c2 → Etale c2 →
  ∀ (F : Finset (CxPts s' (RingHom.id ℂ))), (∀ y, y ∈ F ↔ y.1 ≫ c1 = y.1 ≫ c2) →
  ∀ A : CxPts s' (RingHom.id ℂ) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
    (∀ y ∈ F, GlobalTheory.W1.IsTan d c1 c2 h1 h2 y (A y) ∧ (1 - A y).det ≠ 0) →
  ∀ a : ℕ, (∀ b, FiniteDimensional ℂ (hodgeH s a b)) ∧
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ b * LinearMap.trace ℂ _ (hodgeTrace h1 a b ∘ₗ hodgePull h2 a b) =
      ∑ y ∈ F, (Matrix.det (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • (A y).map Polynomial.C)).coeff a / (1 - A y).det

def BernsteinZelevinskyFiniteness : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [ValuativeRel k] [TopologicalSpace k] [IsNonarchimedeanLocalField k],
    IrreducibleAdmissible k ∧ JacquetFiniteLength k ∧ InductionFiniteLength k ∧
      InductionContragredient k

def ResKStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [CharZero K] (M D : ℕ) (X : Scheme.{0}) (i : X ⟶ PSpace K M) (U : X.Opens),
    IsResInput M i U D →
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (X' : Scheme.{0}) (j : X' ⟶ pullback (PSpace.str K M) (PSpace.str K r)) (f : X' ⟶ X),
      IsClosedImmersion j ∧ f ≫ i = j ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ∧ IsResWithCoords (i ≫ PSpace.str K M) U D f

def GreenRegularCharacters : Prop :=
  ∀ (g : ℕ) [Fact g.Prime] (d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod g) K], Module.finrank (ZMod g) K = d →
    ∃ τ : (Kˣ →* ℂˣ) → Gn g d → ℂ,
      (∀ θ, IsRegularChar g d θ → IsCusp (τ θ) ∧ τ θ 1 = ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 d, ((g : ℂ) ^ i - 1) ∧
        ∀ y : Gn g d, Irreducible (y : Mt g d).charpoly → ∀ z : Kˣ, aeval (z : K) (y : Mt g d).charpoly = 0 →
          τ θ y = (-1) ^ (d - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ((θ (z ^ g ^ i) : ℂˣ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ θ θ', IsRegularChar g d θ → IsRegularChar g d θ' → (τ θ = τ θ' ↔ ∃ i < d, θ' = θ ^ g ^ i)) ∧
      ∀ χ : Gn g d → ℂ, IsCusp χ → ∃ θ, IsRegularChar g d θ ∧ χ = τ θ

def DualAbelianScheme : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{0}) (A : Over S) [GrpObj A], IsAbelianScheme A →
    ∃ (B : Over S) (_ : GrpObj B) (P : LB (A ⊗ B).left), IsAbelianScheme B ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, SmoothOfRelativeDimension g A.hom → SmoothOfRelativeDimension g B.hom) ∧
      IsDual A B P ∧ IsDual B A (swap P)

def EisBL : Prop :=
  ∀ (F E : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Algebra F E] (σ : E →ₐ[F] E) (B : Base F E) (n : ℕ) (Y : Spc F E n) r s, B.IsGood σ → 1 ≤ n → (Y.IsHerm σ B r s ∨ Y.IsSkew σ B r s) →
    ∀ χ : Chr F E, IsHecke F E χ → ∀ c : ℕ, ResEtaPow (Units.map (algebraMap F (AF F)).toMonoidHom).range χ c →
    ∀ b K a, IsFrame2 σ Y b → IsStdK (σ := σ) (Y := Y) B b K → IsHgt K a → ∀ s₁ f, IsSec K χ s₁ f →
      ∃ Ê : ℂ → G2 σ Y → ℂ, (∃ t : ℝ, (∀ s : ℂ, t < s.re → ∀ x, HasSum (eisTerm (flat a f s₁ s) x) (Ê s x)) ∧
          ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Ê · x) {s | t < s.re}) ∧
        ∀ s₀, ∃ (k : ℕ) (U : Set ℂ) (H : ℂ → modFun σ Y), U ∈ 𝓝 s₀ ∧ (∀ s ∈ U, s ≠ s₀ → ∀ x, (H s).1 x = (s - s₀) ^ k * Ê s x) ∧
          ∀ μ, IsGrowForm μ → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => μ (H s)) U

def Green : Prop :=
  ∀ (g : ℕ) [Fact g.Prime] (L : LabelDatum g) (d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∃ τ : (ZMod g)[X] → Gn g d → ℂ,
    (∀ P, IsPrimeLab d P → IsCuspOf L P (τ P) ∧ τ P 1 = ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 d, ((g : ℂ) ^ i - 1)) ∧
    (∀ P P', IsPrimeLab d P → IsPrimeLab d P' → τ P = τ P' → P = P') ∧
    ∀ χ : Gn g d → ℂ, IsCusp χ → ∃ P, IsPrimeLab d P ∧ χ = τ P

  ∀ (F E : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Algebra F E] (σ : E →ₐ[F] E) (B : Base F E) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Spc F E m) (Y : Spc F E n) r s r' s', B.IsGood σ → 1 ≤ m → 1 ≤ n → min r s = 0 →
    (A.IsHerm σ B r s ∧ Y.IsSkew σ B r' s' ∨ A.IsSkew σ B r s ∧ Y.IsHerm σ B r' s') →
    ∀ χ : Chr F E, IsHecke F E χ → ResEtaPow (Units.map (algebraMap F (AF F)).toMonoidHom).range χ m →

    ∀ b K a, IsFrame2 σ Y b → IsStdK (σ := σ) (Y := Y) B b K → IsHgt K a →

    ∀ Φ ∈ schA F κ, FiniteDimensional ℂ (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun k : K => om k.1 Φ)) →
      EisValueAt (flat a (fun x => l (om x Φ)) (((m : ℂ) - n) / 2)) (((m : ℂ) - n) / 2)
